rec.name: Testimonial Videos Section (with brand-name badge)
rec.status: Built in dev theme (brand default set to "PsyCommerce")

what.text: A section titled "Testimonial Videos" that lets customers speak for the brand. The screenshot shows only the text side: the headline "Wir lassen unsere Kund:innen sprechen" (We let our customers speak), and a sub-line "Schau dir an, was andere über [Brand] zu sagen haben" (See what others say about [Brand]). Below these is an underlined CTA "Jetzt mehr erfahren →" (Learn more). A dark circular badge overlaps the headline and reads "300.000+ KUND:INNEN LIEBEN [BRAND]" (300,000+ customers love [BRAND]). The brand name appears in two places, the sub-line and the badge, and both are highlighted in the screenshot. The testimonial videos themselves are not visible in the screenshot.

why.text: Real customers on video are a strong form of social proof, because faces and voices feel more authentic than written reviews. The badge adds a large-number bandwagon cue (300,000+ customers). The brand name in the copy ties the proof to the store. The CTA gives interested visitors a next step.

how.text: Build it as a reusable theme section with a text column (heading, sub-line containing a brand-name variable, CTA link) and a round badge overlay. Per the comments, the brand name appears in two places (sub-line and badge). Both default to "PsyCommerce" so the section shows a sensible name when added to any new page or store. Each client then overrides the name in the theme editor. Video blocks (upload or embed) go alongside the text column. The ticket gives no detail on how they are laid out.

items: Badge text: customer count (e.g. "300.000+"), "Kund:innen lieben" and brand name (default "PsyCommerce")
Testimonial video blocks (source, poster image) — assumed, not shown in the screenshot

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are mentioned in the ticket. The brand-name default is hard-coded in the section schema (dev theme code updated by Jani). Video hosting or embed method is unknown.

items: Conversion rate for sessions that saw the section

images.caption: Text side of the section: headline, sub-line with brand name, CTA, and the dark round badge with the customer count and brand name. The two brand-name fields are boxed in red.
The two highlighted brand-name fields (sub-line and badge) are the configurable text defaulting to "PsyCommerce".
